fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set 'Update github runner to'. No owner was present; the planner raised one question (serves, main CI, ci install template, workflow push access) and the arbiter answered with Decision ci-main-and-cancel. Settled: the change set serves milestone-25; ship-change's wait-main stops waiting on GitHub and instead compares the merge commit's tree with the tested PR head's tree locally, failing with a stop: line on a mismatch; the rhiza ci install template gains a per-PR concurrency group with cancel-in-progress but keeps its push-to-main check; agent leaves touch only Go code, and the .github/workflows/ci.yml edit (drop push trigger, add concurrency) is left to the owner to push by hand with a workflow-scoped token after the ship change lands, because the agents' gh token lacks the workflow scope.
fields.title: Plan: cancel stale CI runs, stop re-testing on main
